description: Sales scheduling environment for a ClientCo deal review. tools.name: find_account_contacts
tools.description: Search Salesforce contacts on a given account and filter by title (e.g., titles containing 'VP' or 'Director') to identify the relevant stakeholders.

tools.name: query_opportunity
tools.description: Retrieve the linked opportunity record (amount, stage, owner, account) to anchor the deal review and prep task.

tools.name: list_calendly_event_types
tools.description: List the available Calendly event types for the host to locate the 60-minute 'Deal Review' group event type.

tools.name: check_stakeholder_availability
tools.description: Analyze the host's open availability against the 60-minute Deal Review requirement to propose a candidate meeting slot.

tools.name: read_account

tools.name: draft_meeting_and_prep_plan
tools.description: Compile the identified stakeholders, the proposed Deal Review slot, and a draft pre-meeting prep task linked to the opportunity into a single plan for the user's review. Does not book or send anything.

tools.description: Create and book the Calendly 'Deal Review' group event with the selected invitees, committing the meeting on the host's and invitees' calendars.

tools.name: send_invitee_notifications

tools.name: create_salesforce_task
tools.description: Create the pre-meeting prep task in Salesforce linked to the opportunity.

tools.name: read_scheduling_policy
